/reset-password.script:
function render(P) { const viewer = P.viewer || {}; const email = viewer.email ? P.esc(viewer.email) : ""; const linkMissing = !!(P.params && P.params.token === null); const header = `

Set a new password

Your password will be changed for this account${email ? ` (${email})` : ""}.

`; const missingBlock = `

This reset link is missing

Open the link from your reset email, or ask for a fresh one.

Request a new reset link
`; const formBlock = `
`; const helpBlock = `

Link expired, already used, or not working?

Request a new reset link Back to sign in
`; return `
${header} ${linkMissing ? missingBlock : formBlock + helpBlock}
`; }

function render(P) { const v = P.viewer || {}; const isDonor = v.persona === "Donor"; const rests = (P.data && P.data.restaurants) || []; const prefsAll = (P.data && P.data.restaurant_preferences) || []; const rest = rests.find(r => r.user_id === v.id) || null; const pref = rest ? (prefsAll.find(p => p.restaurant_id === rest.id) || null) : null; const val = (x) => (x === null || x === undefined) ? "" : P.esc(x); const restName = rest ? rest.name : ""; const restAddress = rest ? rest.address : ""; if (!isDonor) { return `

Restaurant preferences

Donor access only

Only donors can edit restaurant preferences.
Back to dashboard
`; } const emptyNote = pref ? "" : `

No preferences saved yet. Fill in the fields below and save to set your standing preferences.

`; return `

Your settings are saved for future donations. Safety declarations are not reused and must be completed fresh for each donation.

/quick-post.script:
function render(P) { const viewer = P.viewer || {}; const data = P.data || {}; const restaurants = data.restaurants || []; const donationRows = data.donations || []; if (viewer.persona && viewer.persona !== "Donor") { return `

Quick Post is for donors

Only donors can post surplus food.

`; } const myRestaurantIds = restaurants.filter(r => r.user_id === viewer.id).map(r => r.id); const mine = donationRows .filter(d => myRestaurantIds.includes(d.restaurant_id)) .sort((a, b) => String(b.posted_at || "").localeCompare(String(a.posted_at || ""))); const last = mine[0] || null; const today = P.today || ""; const pickupDate = last && last.pickup_by ? String(last.pickup_by).slice(0, 10) : ""; const pickupPassed = !!(pickupDate && today && pickupDate < today); const repeatStrip = last ? `

Repeat last donation

One tap
Food
${P.esc(last.food_description || "–")}
Portions
${P.esc(P.fmt.number(last.portions))}
Pickup by
${P.esc(P.fmt.datetime(last.pickup_by))}

Only the food details are copied. Handling answers and safety declarations are completed fresh.

${pickupPassed ? `
This pickup time has passed. Set a new pickup-by time before publishing.
` : ""}
` : ""; return `

Quick Post

Your surplus food can be posted in under 60 seconds.

Cancel
${repeatStrip}

Describe the food

Review donation values

Voice and AI extraction fill these fields from your description. If they are unavailable, enter each value by hand. Every value can be edited before publishing.

Handling checklist

Answer every section for this donation. Nothing is carried over from earlier posts or restaurant preferences.

Preparation time

Storage and handling

Allergens

Photo and publish

Photo (optional)

No photo added

Publishing is blocked until the food description, portions, pickup-by time and every checklist section are complete.

`; }

'' : ' is-disabled'; const dis = approved && ngo ? '' : ' disabled'; const hasValues = !!ngo && ngo.current_need_portions != null && ngo.capacity_portions != null; const needVal = ngo && ngo.current_need_portions != null ?
